description: Deception technologies such as honeypots and honeynets are not deployed to detect attackers. This signal indicates that adversary reconnaissance and lateral movement may not be detected early.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring advanced detection. Includes honeypots, honeynets, decoy systems, and deception-based detection mechanisms.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through deception technology deployment review, honeypot presence verification, and decoy system assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
